what: How long the scripts/check.py step of the ci workflow took on the GitHub-hosted runner in the three most recent push runs that succeeded (read on 2026-11-05, before the run of the next push). README.md says how long the check takes on a CI runner; tests/test_readme_numbers.py rounds the shortest of these steps to the nearest half hour and the longest up to the next half hour, and compares them with the words the README types. The steps are 104.9, 107.1 and 120.4 minutes, so the shortest sits 8 seconds below the 105-minute edge and the longest 22 seconds above the 120-minute edge; when this file is refreshed, the README, the page's two sentences and the pin in scripts/check_site.py are edited together with it. This file is a record of what was read, not a proof; the runs are on the public repository's Actions page.
source: GitHub API, repos/JacoboPacheco/third-of-a-percent/actions/runs/<id>/jobs, the step named 'scripts/check.py' of the job 'check'; runs listed by gh run list --workflow ci.yml, event push, conclusion success
